Grace's team owns the macro fix","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"Priya offered to build the policy and have it back by Tuesday the sixth, and Grace said the macro fix is on them, so neither is stated more firmly than spoken.","utterance_ids":["U054","U062"]},{"check":"email_promises_uncommitted","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Release note, drop-location email, invite to Dana and Elena, realistic onboarding plan","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"Each promised item was committed in the call: release note (U038), file-drop email (U081), invite (U072), onboarding plan (U077), and Mikkel's Monday sample (U075).","utterance_ids":["U038","U081","U072","U077","U075"]},{"check":"buying_signal_overstated","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Recap framing of customer reactions","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"The email reports only facts shown and agreed next steps, and does not claim a decision or approval from the customer.","utterance_ids":["U060","U080"]}]}
